one_liner: Grain is an AI meeting memory platform that records or ingests calls, generates notes/action items, and exposes meeting data via a public API and an official MCP server.
access_notes: Personal Access Tokens are available on all plans; OAuth public clients can self-register via client metadata; Workspace Access Tokens and the OAuth workspace scope require Business/Enterprise and Grain verification (app review).
blocker_notes: Workspace (organization-level) OAuth scope requires Grain verification; Workspace Access Tokens are only available on Business/Enterprise plans.
